## Summary

Understanding customer groups is essential for effective marketing. This paper applies the K-means clustering algorithm to segment customers and derive profiles that support targeted, data-driven marketing strategies.

## Contribution

- End-to-end customer segmentation workflow with K-means.
- Translates clustering results into actionable marketing strategy.
- Builds on industry experience applying segmentation at a retail loyalty platform.
